profile.name: SQR1三球六自由度运动平台
profile.description: 一套通过EPICS控制的三球六自由度运动平台，可对X、Y、Z三个平移轴以及rX、rY、rZ三个转动轴进行单轴或联动控制。适用于实验中样品、光学元件或工装的精密定位与姿态调整。
profile.description_en: An EPICS-controlled tri-sphere six-axis motion stage that supports individual or coordinated control of X, Y, Z translations and rX, rY, rZ rotations. It is used in laboratories for precise positioning and angular alignment of samples, optics, or fixtures.
